adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb the “success” examples mostly assert interactions (mocking TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed and TopicRetriever.new/retrieve) and one expectation on TopicView.new, but they never exercise rendering the embed/best view with real TopicView/posts data. They also don’t assert any caching headers set by discourse_expires_in 1.minute in EmbedController#best (they only check X-Frame-Options). Note: the finding’s claim that TopicView.new with {best: 5} is unverified is inaccurate—there is an expectation for it—but it’s still a mock-wiring test rather than an end-to-end render.
